summary: An inventory directory can hold many files of any format or plugin config, including mixed static, plugin and script sources, which Ansible aggregates as one inventory; ignored patterns are configurable.
questions: How do I split my inventory into multiple files?
Can I mix an OpenStack inventory plugin with static hosts?
How do I point Ansible at an inventory folder?

answer_card.title: Organize inventory in a directory
answer_card.answer_md:
Put several sources in one directory and target it:
```text
inventory/
  openstack.yml          # inventory plugin config
  dynamic-inventory.py   # script
  on-prem                # static hosts
  parent-groups          # static groups
```
```bash
ansible-playbook example.yml -i inventory
```
Good for per-team files. Ignored names are set by `INVENTORY_IGNORE_PATTERNS` and `INVENTORY_IGNORE_EXTS`. You can also set the directory in `ansible.cfg`.
